usage.label: including／inclusive of／included 的位置
usage.explanationZh: 名詞前可使用 including 或 inclusive of；名詞後則使用過去分詞 included。

usage.label: be associated with...

usage.label: in association with...

usage.label: a mere + 數字
usage.explanationZh: 僅僅若干……；= merely + 數字；= only + 數字。

usage.label: including / inclusive of + N; N + included
usage.explanationZh: 名詞前使用 including 或 inclusive of；名詞後使用 included。

usage.label: equip, equipped, equipped
usage.explanationZh: equip 的過去式與過去分詞都雙寫 p。
